Exercise 5 — Word Formation 
1. The pressure to meet expectations can affect children's emotional 
_________ (stable). 
2. Parents must allow children gradual _________ (independent) in 
decision-making. 
3. Strong values support children's moral _________ (develop). 
4. Excessive control may reduce a child's _________ (confident). 
5. Open communication strengthens family _________ (relate). 
 
IELTS-Style Essay Topic 
"Some people believe that parents should make important decisions 
for their children, while others argue that children should be free to 
make their own choices. Discuss both views and give your own 
opinion."
